title: Legal, License & Compliance (KVKK/GDPR)
rules: MIT / Apache-2.0 / BSD code may be reused with attribution preserved.
GPL / AGPL code must never be copied into proprietary code: clean-room only.
Unknown or missing license equals all-rights-reserved: treat as copyleft.
Personal data needs a lawful basis, a retention period and a deletion path.
Data subject requests (access, deletion, portability) need a documented SLA.
Cross-border transfers require an explicit legal mechanism.
Logs must not contain personal data beyond what the purpose requires.
redFlags: vendored GPL file in proprietary repo
checklist: Is every dependency license recorded with SPDX id in the SBOM?
Is there a data map (what, where, why, how long)?
Is deletion honored across backups within policy window?
Are minors' data flows explicitly handled?
Is attribution text present for permissive licenses?

scoringRubric.1-3: Exposed: license violations, no data map, PII in logs.
scoringRubric.4-6: Incomplete: some records, unclear retention, manual processes.
scoringRubric.7-8: Compliant: SBOM, data map, retention policy, tested deletion.
scoringRubric.9-10: Audit-proof: automated license gates, DPIA per feature, verified DSAR SLA.
